_comment: Published list prices, USD per million tokens. Used only to turn a token count into a dollar figure — the token counts themselves come from the provider's usage field and never from this file. If your contract rate differs, edit it here; the percentage saved does not change.
_source: Mirrors packages/anyray-observability/src/pricing/data.ts in the Anyray monorepo, which is the source of truth the console bills from. Keep them in step: a rate here that disagrees with the console is a number a customer can catch us on.

cache._comment: Multipliers on the model's input rate, matching the gateway's house tiers. A cache write costs more than a fresh read of the same bytes; a cache read costs far less. Models that depart from the house read tier declare cacheRead below.
